lines.en: I walk sideways and never change my line.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，沙上留印。
lines.en: Eight legs move at once, printing the sand.

lines.zh: 礁石缝太窄，我侧身挤过去。
lines.en: The reef gap is narrow; I squeeze sideways.
The tide is out; I go looking for food.
Dry sand swallows my legs as I step.

lines.zh: 我举着一只螯，保持平衡。
lines.en: I hold one claw up to keep balance.
Sideways is faster than straight ahead.
I creep along the waterline, slowly.
My shell raps a stone with a hollow click.

lines.zh: 前面有片海藻，我绕过去。
lines.en: There is kelp ahead; I go around it.
My steps leave rows of little pits.

lines.zh: 退潮露出的石头归我巡逻。
lines.en: The rocks the tide uncovers are mine to patrol.
Many legs have one advantage: steadiness.
I stop walking, but my eye stalks turn.

lines.zh: 我踩过一道湿沙，印子很快没了。
lines.en: I cross wet sand; my prints fade fast.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，才挤过那道石缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways to fit the crevice.
I hold my claw high and stay still.

lines.zh: 沙上有浪打过来的白沫。
lines.en: White foam slides up the sand toward me.
I grind the rim of my shell on stone.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹躲在我影子下。
lines.en: A tiny crab hides under my shadow.
After the ebb, the air tastes of salt.
Tiny bubbles leak from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在柄上，看得远。
lines.en: My eyes sit on stalks and see far.
Shell fragments glitter across the sand.

lines.zh: 我听见浪在石缝里回响。
lines.en: I hear waves echoing in the rock gaps.
This claw is bigger than the other one.

lines.zh: 我蹲在湿沙上，等潮回来。
lines.en: I squat on wet sand, waiting for the tide.

lines.zh: 海鸥的影子掠过，我缩了缩。
lines.en: A gull's shadow passes; I shrink down.
A little water pools under my shell.
I clean my legs one by one.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，比我高不了多少。
lines.en: Crouched down, you are barely taller than me.
Your hand comes near; up goes my claw.
Don't poke my shell with that finger.
A crab is scuttling by your foot.
I tilt my head and my eye stalks turn.
You stand on the tide line, shoes wet.
I am not afraid, nor coming closer.
That thing in your hand is catching light.

lines.zh: 我先眨眼，你就往前一步。
lines.en: I blink first, and you take one step closer.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的沙窝。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the hollow in my sand.
A pale mark has appeared on my shell.
The blow sent me skidding sideways.
One leg is loose, but I can still walk.
I raise my claws to cover my eyes.
The pain makes me blow a string of bubbles.
Such wounds are common on the reef.
I sidestep backwards into the rock gap.

lines.zh: 沙被震起来，糊了我一脸。
lines.en: Sand flew up and caked my whole face.
No second blow; my shell would break.
I pull my legs in and wait it out.

lines.zh: 那块鱼肉，放到沙上就好。
lines.en: Leave that fish on the sand for me.

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味，螯都张开了。
lines.en: I smell fish, and my claws open wide.
Kelp is too tough; I am not eager.

lines.zh: 你退开两步，我才敢过去。
lines.en: Step back two paces and I will approach.
Stop waving it; my eyes go dizzy.

lines.zh: 这么香，是刚捞上来的吧。
lines.en: So fresh, it must be newly caught.
I shuffle sideways slower than you think.
Toss it farther; I dislike a scramble.
That piece is mine; not for the small crab.
First I will test it with one claw.
You kicked me and I flipped over.

lines.zh: 壳磕在礁石上，掉了点屑。
lines.en: My shell hit the reef and chipped.
I clamped your shoelace and won't let go.
A wave shoved me against your leg.
I scuttled three steps to the side.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的沙窝踩塌了。
lines.en: That step collapsed the hollow I dug.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的影子，我就跑。
lines.en: You step on my shadow, so I run.
Half the water sloshed out of my shell.
My legs are tangled in the seaweed.
Move aside; I cannot pass sideways.
We walk sideways, side by side.
Your claws are redder than mine.
This patch of reef is enough for us both.
Let's talk again when the tide comes in.
Don't pinch me; I know you're nervous.
First we dig ourselves a shallow burrow.
You lead, I follow, both sideways.
Shell against shell makes a soft sound.

lines.zh: 这一带的海水还算干净。
lines.en: The water around here is still clean.

lines.zh: 退潮时，我们各自守一边。
lines.en: At low tide, we each guard one side.

lines.zh: 你把我抓起来，螯还张着。
lines.en: You lift me up; my claws still open.
Don't squeeze my shell sides; it cracks.
My legs claw at the empty air.
Held upside down, my head spins.
Please put me back on the reef.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度传到我壳上。
lines.en: Your palm's warmth seeps into my shell.
I did not pinch you; consider that courtesy.
Out of water, I breathe in quick bursts.
Each step you take jolts me three times.
Grains of sand still cling inside my seam.
Something under the sand is bubbling.
I have my eye on that piece of fish.
That little crab is coming much too close.
There is something pale at the reef's edge.
I shuffle sideways in that direction.
I am determined to get that shell.
First I reach out with a single claw.
If it bolts, I will never catch it.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛对准了那个方向。
lines.en: I point both eye stalks that way.
I wait for a wave to push it closer.
Claws raised, I stare without blinking.
It moves, and my legs go taut.
I edge sideways and block its path.

lines.zh: 沙上那点动静瞒不过我。
lines.en: That tiny stir in the sand betrays it.
Claws wide open, ready to snap.
One step nearer and my patience runs out.
It is smaller than me, but quicker.
I lower my body flush with the sand.
This standoff is mine; I will not back off.
My eye stalks track it without pause.
One snap and it retreated two steps.
I caught hold of its tail.
My shell is hard; blows barely register.
One pinch is enough; I do not chase.
Sand flies everywhere as we scuffle.

lines.zh: 我的力气都在这只大螯里。
lines.en: All my strength lives in this big claw.
It pinched back, and I still held.
Keep your hands away; a pinch hurts.
I flip it over, then withdraw.

lines.zh: 滩涂上的规矩，先到先得。
lines.en: The flats have one rule: first come, first served.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，壳还湿。
lines.en: I climb out of sand with a wet shell.
The tide just left; the flats are full of food.
The reef crack is cold but safe.
First I take one sideways lap around.
Fine sand here, good for digging.
A spiral shell lies right beside me.
The waves sound close; I know this place.
First I open my claws and test the water.

lines.zh: 我的同类应该就在附近。
lines.en: My own kind should be somewhere nearby.

lines.zh: 退潮的石头缝是我的地盘。
lines.en: The rocks the tide bares are my territory.

lines.zh: 壳被烤热了，我往水里跑。
lines.en: My shell heats up; I run for the water.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，壳边崩了口。
lines.en: I fell from height and chipped my rim.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会闷，别按我。
lines.en: Even in water I can drown; don't hold me down.

lines.zh: 炸起的沙子把我埋了一半。
lines.en: The blast buried half of me in sand.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我壳上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell, unremovable.
That light dulled the colors on my shell.
Three days and I have found nothing to eat.

lines.zh: 雷劈在礁石上，我的腿发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the reef; my legs went numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有沙，也没有潮声。
lines.en: No sand here, and no sound of tides.
